rule_text: Prefer: Requirements cite standards and specifications rather than restating numerical values inline.

variants: Prefer active, direct language over negative constructions in requirements statements.
Prefer active, direct language: 'minimum of' is clearer and more concise than negated comparatives
Prefer positive statements: 'within X seconds' is clearer than double-negative phrasing.
Prefer: Requirements cite standards and specifications rather than restating numerical values inline.

rule_text: Prefer active voice 'shall move' over passive 'shall be able to move'.

variants: Prefer active voice 'shall move' over passive 'shall be able to move'.
Prefer active voice: 'shall use maximum' is clearer than 'shall not use more'
Prefer imperative 'shall move' over 'shall be able to move' for clarity.
Prefer: Active voice 'shall move' is clearer and more direct than 'shall be able to move'
